QuestInfo.name: [Combo God] God Among Combo Men
QuestInfo.0: Anyone can summon the Combo Gods 300 times. It's just a matter of luck. A true combo master should aspire to greater things.
QuestInfo.1: If you summon the Combo Gods 3,333 times, surely they'll have no choice but to acknowledge you!
QuestInfo.2: You've summoned the Combo God 3,333 times and were honored for your achievement!
